applicability.Brown_ER: q any prime power; order q^2+q+1, degree bound q+1, diameter2, Property R per PolarStar Theorem3. q16 is valid.
applicability.IQ: superdegree d >=0 and d mod4 in {0,3}; superorder2d+2. Do not apply at d6 or d9.
applicability.Paley: 2d+1 a prime power congruent1mod4, d even; Paley13 has d6 and PropertyR1, valid with BrownER16.
applicability.Delorme_single_GQ_polarity: q=2^(2m+1), m>=0; q16 invalid. This restriction does not apply to opposite_GQ.
applicability.opposite_GQ: Existing GQ(s,t); does not require polarity on the original GQ. Payne q4 gives (s,t)=(3,5); degree24/order6144.
applicability.opposite_GQ_exact_degree: GQ(3,5) has64points and96lines. Quotient vertices are point-line pairs:6144. 384incident flags lose a loop and have degree23; other5760 vertices degree24. Thus this 6144point construction is not a cap23 counterexample.
